Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class AcousticPumpBoundary

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.AcousticPumpBoundary
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class AcousticPumpBoundary extends Object implements Serializable
Forward-only quasi-steady pump characteristic for the existing single-liquid acoustic inlet.

A detached PumpChart fits the supplied reference-speed data and applies its affinity laws. The original reduced-flow interval and an explicit positive-speed interval bound every evaluation; the chart's endpoint clamp is never used as an extrapolation model. A monotone nonincreasing fitted head permits one compatible characteristic root. Equal suction/discharge velocity and elevation bases are assumed, so total head gain equals pressure-head gain. No suction-line storage, density/viscosity correction, shaft inertia, stopped/reverse pump, NPSH or disc model is supplied. The actual-speed table is prescribed data, not a commanded speed or inferred driver dynamics.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • AcousticPumpBoundary

      public AcousticPumpBoundary(double referenceSpeed, double[] flow, double[] head, double[] efficiency, String headUnit, double minimumSpeed, double maximumSpeed, double[] timeSeconds, double[] speedRpm, double suctionPressureBara, String source)
      Create a detached reference curve and prescribed actual-speed history.
      Parameters:
      referenceSpeed - reference curve speed, positive rpm
      flow - reference actual volume flow, strictly increasing nonnegative m3/hour, at least three points
      head - reference nonnegative nonincreasing pump head in the declared unit
      efficiency - reference efficiencies, percent, positive and at most 100
      headUnit - exactly meter or kJ/kg
      minimumSpeed - declared lower applicable speed, positive rpm
      maximumSpeed - declared upper applicable speed, rpm
      timeSeconds - strictly increasing absolute times starting at zero, at least two points
      speedRpm - prescribed actual speeds within the declared range; endpoints are held outside the table
      suctionPressureBara - fixed absolute suction pressure at the matching velocity/elevation basis, bara
      source - source/applicability declaration, nonempty; synthetic data must be labelled synthetic
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if data are invalid or the fitted head is not monotone nonincreasing
